IncidentDef.label: geological backlash
IncidentDef.letterText: The land is pushing back against your terraforming. Artificial soils collapse, reclaimed banks slump, and muddy scars open where you forced the terrain.

IncidentDef.label: soil collapse
IncidentDef.letterText: Overworked seedbeds and amended soils have slumped into exhausted hardpan. The colony pushed fertility past what the ground could hold.
